title: Review-value queue and kill gate 6
description: The ranked review queue and kill gate 6 measurement. Ratified 2026-08-17 in C1. Four design constraints are enforced by construction. Every claim carries the count it was measured over, because a queue that surfaces four observations and gets three right is not 75% precision unless the denominator is stated. Every verdict is a four-valued enum with a not-measurable state, because a verdict that can only be good news is not a verdict. An absent measurement carries its reason, because a silent null is a suppressed finding. And the script validates its own output against this schema before writing, so a violating receipt never reaches disk.

split_manifest_sha256.description: Digest of the split manifest. A re-split invalidates all numbers here.

conflict_definition.description: The definition of an actionable conflict, fixed before ranking, not changed after seeing results.

fixed_before_measuring.description: Attestation that the definition was not changed after seeing the lift result.

review_budget.description: The fixed review budget used for all lift comparisons. Chosen before results were seen.

deduplication.description: Episode deduplication: one observation per (station, satellite, revolution) episode.

key.description: The fields that define an episode.

sha256_duplicate_policy.description: What happens when two episodes share a waterfall SHA-256.

n_sha256_duplicates_in_corpus.description: Measured count of SHA-256 duplicates in the corpus. Zero means the dedup rule was untested by the data; the test suite covers it with a constructed case.

queue.description: The ranked queue. One entry per episode, sorted descending by score.

verdict.description: Four states. NOT_ESTABLISHED means the point estimate is in the right direction but the interval spans the threshold. NOT_MEASURABLE means a split lacked the data to measure at all.

episode_key.description: Canonical string form of (ground_station, norad_cat_id, orbital_revolution).

reasons.description: Fixed vocabulary. NO_REASON means the observation is ranked but triggers no conflict criterion.

is_conflict.description: True iff at least one actionable reason (not OFFSET_AT_BOUND, not NO_REASON) applies.

model_prob.description: Calibrated image_corridor probability. Null when the image is missing.

ensemble_uncertainty.description: Standard deviation of the image_corridor episode-bootstrap ensemble for this observation. Null when not available.

n_queue_examined.description: Count of observations inspected at budget. A null here means the split was not measurable.

n_random_conflicts.description: Expected actionable conflicts at budget under random ordering.

n_queue_conflicts.description: Actionable conflicts found by the queue at budget.

lift_point.description: n_queue_conflicts / n_random_conflicts. Values above 1.5 are the target.

lift_vs_fifo.description: Point lift of queue over FIFO ordering.

lift_vs_image_uncertainty.description: Point lift of queue over image-only uncertainty ordering.

lift_vs_physics_only.description: Point lift of queue over physics-only (AUC-ranked) ordering.

verdict.description: PASSED: interval lo > 1.5. NOT_ESTABLISHED: point > 1.5 but interval spans 1.5. FAILED: point <= 1.5. NOT_MEASURABLE: could not be measured.

n_groups.description: Number of pass episodes used for bootstrap resampling.
